feature.description: Vertical slice for one domain module, whole or one layer at a time (--layer): schema + spec, Dexie table registration, repository + test, hook + spec, component shell + spec, barrel.

entity.description: One entity's data layer, whole or one layer at a time (--layer): Zod schema + spec, table registration, fixture factory, repository + test. --remote emits a Supabase migration stub and repository instead of Dexie's.

integration.description: Client/schema/adapter triple for one external integration. --kind=wallet emits the AuthProvider/WalletProvider stub pair instead.
